constructs.name: vlan
constructs.description: a local broadcast domain: a VLAN and the ports in it

variables.endpoints[].vlan: optional; shared by every endpoint; named from 100-999, or omitted and one is allocated

examples: create a vlan 120 on leaf01 ethernet-1/1 for tenant acme
a local vlan on leaf01 ethernet-1/2 and leaf01 ethernet-1/3 for tenant blue

constructs.name: mac-vrf
constructs.description: a VLAN extended over the fabric by an L2VNI with EVPN route targets

variables.endpoints[].vlan: optional; shared by every endpoint; named from 100-999, or omitted and one is allocated
variables.anycast_gateway: optional; ipv4 and/or ipv6 address with prefix length; makes the mac-vrf route

examples: extend vlan 100 as a mac-vrf across leaf01 ethernet-1/1 and leaf02 ethernet-1/1 for tenant blue
a mac-vrf with anycast gateway 10.10.0.1/24 on leaf01 ethernet-1/1 for tenant blue

constructs.name: ip-vrf
constructs.description: a routed instance: a VRF with an L3VNI and route targets

variables.endpoints[].vlan: optional per endpoint; named from 100-999 for a tagged routed subinterface; omitted means the untagged subinterface, never allocated
variables.ipv4_prefixes / ipv6_prefixes: at least one prefix across both families

examples: an ip-vrf on leaf01 ethernet-1/1 vlan 200 for tenant initech advertising 10.50.0.0/24
route 10.60.0.0/24 for tenant blue on leaf02 ethernet-1/2 untagged

constructs.name: acl
constructs.description: a filter bound to the attachment subinterfaces a service occupies

variables.endpoints[].vlan: optional; names which existing subinterface to bind (a reference, either band)
variables.acl.rules[]: name, priority 1-65534 (distinct, ascending first match), action permit|deny, protocol, prefixes, ports

examples: permit ingress tcp 443 from 10.0.0.0/24 on leaf01 ethernet-1/1 vlan 100 for tenant acme, deny everything else
